title: Payments and Reductions on Bed-Hold Charges
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — receipts and reductions.**

A payment names the bed-hold charge it pays and is applied only up to its open balance, by one of the accepted methods; a transfer from the resident's trust account is posted only on the resident's authorization recorded with the trust account. A charge is reduced when its days are reversed, when it covers days held before the transfer notice was delivered (notice not given), when the payer still had covered days for them (payer days available), or for a billing error; each reduction names the charge and never exceeds its open balance. Charges on an ended reservation stay due until paid, and prepaid held days after a release are refunded. A charge is reduced once per reason.

### Open balance and the amount applied

The open balance of a charge, as of the posting date, is its amount less every payment and every reduction already naming it. The amount applied by a payment is the lower of the amount tendered and that open balance.

| Hypothetical charge | Already applied | Open balance | Tendered | Applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1,194.00 | 500.00 paid | 694.00 | 900.00 | 694.00 |
| 1,194.00 | 500.00 paid, 140.00 reduced | 554.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 |

### Reduction reasons

| Reason | When |
|---|---|
| returned earlier | the charge's days are reversed because they fall after the return |
| hospital discharged elsewhere | the charge's days are reversed because they fall after a hospital discharge to another setting |
| payer days available | the payer still had covered days for them |
| notice not given | the charge covers days held before the transfer notice was delivered |
| billing error | the charge was made in error |

A charge already reduced for a reason is not reduced again for that same reason; it may be reduced for a different reason. Accepted methods are those in the tier's billing terms: check, ACH, card and trust transfer.
